KIRAN FOR MAYOR ★ DUBLIN 2026
# Every Dublin family
# deserves to thrive here.
Dublin is one of the best places to live in California.
But too many of our kids feel anxious and alone,
too many families are stretched thin,
and too many residents feel unheard.
I'm ready to go to work for them on day one.
DONATE NOW
— NOVEMBER 3 GENERAL ELECTION
## Make a Plan to Vote
October
5
Early voting begins.
Vote-by-mail ballots begin mailing and ballot drop boxes are open.
October
19
Voter registration deadline.
After this date, eligible voters can still use conditional (same-day) voter registration through Election Day.
October
24
Vote Centers open.
10-day Vote Centers open for early in-person voting in Alameda County.
Oct. 31: Additional 4-day Vote Centers open throughout Alameda County.
November
3
Election Day.
Last day to vote or return your ballot in person. Vote Centers close at 8:00 PM.
Dates from the Alameda County Registrar of Voters.
Register / Check Registration
— MEET KIRAN
## I didn't come to politics through politics.
01
I work in human-centered systems design. Companies bring me in to assess their organizational structure and lead change management. I also work one-on-one with individuals and small businesses to streamline their finances and logistics, often in people’s homes during their hardest moments: job loss, divorce, or the death of a family member. I help them get organized and leave them with a plan.
I’m also an author and researcher. I’ve published two books, one on how our environments reflect and affect human behavior and one on how guilt shapes decision-making. I’m a published AIAA researcher on human-centered spaceflight, sustainable systems, and emerging space economies.
— WHY DUBLIN
I chose Dublin about four years ago for its quality of life: safe neighborhoods, good schools, and a community that works.
— HOW I’LL GOVERN
I’m an independent, and I take no money from developers or anyone with a financial stake in Dublin’s decisions. Without a council record, I’d ask you to judge me by what I do when no one requires me to act and by how I’ll run the job:
- Basics first. Traffic, downtown, pedestrian safety, streetlights, and sidewalks come before amenity projects.
- No waste. No new projects while others sit half-finished.
- Answer residents. Every request gets tracked and gets a response.
- Measure and report. Clear goals, published progress, and fixing what isn’t working.
02
— NOT BOUGHT. NOT BEHOLDEN.
I take no developer, real estate or SuperPAC money. No consultants, no political machine. I built this campaign, and this website, myself. I owe nothing to anyone but the people of Dublin.
— PUBLISHED RESEARCH
Presented at AIAA forums: Human Spaceflight (2024) · Space Economy (2024) · Space Sustainability (2024) · Cybersecurity (2025)
— WHY I'M RUNNING
## A City That Works Better Together
### It started with asking questions.
Why does something work this way? Who is it working for? And if we know it could work better, why haven't we fixed it?
Living in Dublin turned those questions toward my own city. My background taught me to think in systems: how housing, transportation, infrastructure, local business and city finances affect one another and shape everyday life.
To me, leadership means listening carefully, asking the difficult questions, making informed decisions and owning the results.
Dublin has already built a lot. Now let's make it work better.
## Whatever they say about me,
## I'll keep showing up for you.
You'll find me at school board meetings, neighborhood meetings and your front door. That's the kind of mayor I'll be.
— PRIORITIES
## What I'll Do as Your Mayor
01
PUT OUR KIDS FIRST
Bring the city, DUSD and local providers together on youth mental health, bullying and academic stress, and create real places for teens to belong.
02
BUILD A CITY WHERE NEIGHBORS KNOW EACH OTHER
Parks, events and public spaces designed to bring people together, not keep them apart.
03
GROW SMART, PROTECT OPEN SPACE
Put new homes near transit and jobs, where they make sense, not on open space like Schaefer Ranch.
04
RESPECT EVERY TAX DOLLAR
Go after every county, state and federal grant before asking residents for more, and put each dollar into the roads and services you actually use.
05
MAKE THE EVERYDAY BASICS WORK
Less time in traffic, safe neighborhoods, faster permits for small businesses, and a City Hall that actually answers you.
— The Campaign

By refusing donations from developers and special-interest political action committees, Kiran ensures that every decision made at City Hall prioritizes the residents. This approach emphasizes fiscal responsibility, reducing unnecessary regulations for local businesses, and carefully protecting Dublin's neighborhoods and open spaces. For a transparent and genuinely responsive leader who puts everyday families first, I strongly support Kiran Mohammad.”— Paschalis Ntatsos, San Ramon Mayor Candidate
“Kiran Mohammad is a visionary who isn't afraid to ask hard questions, challenge the status quo, and present new ideas where playing it safe has often been the norm. As a systems thinker and an everyday resident, she embodies the ideals of citizen politics — bringing fresh, thoughtful perspectives to local government for people like you and me.”— Daniel Hor, Dublin City Council District 2 Candidate
“Kiran Mohammad brings a forward-thinking, community-first vision to Dublin. She understands that real progress means thoughtful growth, stronger neighborhoods, and building a city that truly works for the people who call it home.”— Joel Woods, San Ramon Valley Unified School District Area 5 Trustee Candidate

— GET INVOLVED
## Believe in this movement?
## Let's rally together.
This is a grassroots campaign, and there are several ways to help. Volunteer, help us reach Dublin residents, request a yard sign, or support the campaign.
### 01 Volunteer
Knock doors with me, hand out flyers or host a coffee with your neighbors. Share this site, text five Dublin friends and put up a yard sign. Even two hours helps.
Volunteer
### 02 Contact Kiran
Have a question, an idea, or something you think Dublin should be doing better? I’d like to hear from you. Want a yard sign or want me at your neighborhood event? Just ask.
Contact Kiran
### 03 Donate
Every $25 puts my message on more doors, signs and screens. Your donation keeps this campaign visible.
Giving under $25? Scan to give with Zelle (kiranfordublin).

## Support Kiran for Dublin
Why support? This is a grassroots campaign. I take no developer, real estate or PAC money, so it runs on support from Dublin neighbors.
What does it pay for? Campaign outreach: printing, yard signs, materials, and reaching Dublin residents.
How do I contribute? Pick the amount you'd like to give:
Under $25: no form needed. In your Zelle app, send to ZelleTag kiranfordublin and confirm it shows "Kiran Mohammad for Mayor of Dublin 2026." By giving, you confirm you are a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident and the money is your own.
$25 to $99.99: Give $25 to $99.99 (name and address only)
$100 to $500: Give $100 to $500 (name, address, occupation and employer)
### Who Can Contribute
- Individuals contributing must be U.S. citizens or lawful permanent residents
- Contributions are limited to a cumulative total of $500 per contributor, per election
- Full name and street address are required for gifts of $25 or more
- Occupation and employer are required for gifts of $100 or more, or once your total giving reaches $100; if self-employed, please provide the name of your business
- Cash contributions of $100 or more are not permitted
- Contributions must be made from the contributor’s own funds and may not be reimbursed by another person
- Contributions from foreign nationals and temporary visa holders are prohibited
- Contributions are not tax-deductible for federal or state income-tax purposes
